info.title: Item Test API
info.description: API untuk mengelola data dokter phc

get.summary: Get all Item Tests or search by ID or query (Urine filter)

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search by text query (LIKE match, 'urine' filter applied)

200.description: A list of Item Tests (filtered by ID or Urine query)

post.description: Menambahkan item baru ke dalam database.

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: ID dari Item Test yang akan diperbarui

get.summary: Search Lab Trans by ID or query (including urine filter)

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search by text query (LIKE match), filtering for 'urine' if provided

200.description: A list of Lab Trans (filtered by ID or query)

message.example: NIK tidak ditemukan dalam database pasien

get.summary: Get all Lab Trans with a single search parameter

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search by text query (LIKE match), filtering for 'urine' if provided

get.summary: Get all LabTransOthers with optional search

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search by text query (LIKE match), filtering for 'urine' if provided

get.description: Mengambil daftar semua pasien yang terdaftar. Bisa menggunakan parameter pencarian berdasarkan ID atau teks.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Cari berdasarkan ID pasien yang spesifik (integer match).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Cari berdasarkan NIK, FullName, Phone, atau Address dengan pencarian LIKE.

post.description: Menambahkan pasien baru ke dalam database.

put.description: Memperbarui informasi pasien berdasarkan ID yang diberikan.

get.description: Retrieve all support services, with optional ID or search query.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search support services by code or name using LIKE match.

post.description: Menambahkan pasien baru ke dalam database.

put.description: Memperbarui data layanan support yang ada di database.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID dari Support Service yang akan diperbarui

CreateDate.description: Date when the record was created

CreateBy.description: Name of the user who created the record

LastModifiedDate.description: Date when the record was last modified

LastModifiedBy.description: Name of the user who last modified the record

LabTest.description: Test type for the lab transaction

TransDate.description: Transaction date of the lab test

DoctorReferral.description: Doctor who referred the lab test

PatientID.description: ID of the patient associated with the lab test

Age.description: Patient's age during the lab test

FinalStatement.description: Doctor's final statement about the test

FinalResult.description: Final result of the lab test
